data.name: Raze Vol. 1
data.detailed_description:
Quest users on Steam: Requires Oculus/Meta runtime set as default OpenXR.

Raze Vol. 1 is a satirical punk rock VR puzzle-platformer where you team up with Raze—a sharp-tongued leader of an underground punk band—who gets zapped into a twisted alternate reality after a freak stage accident involving her guitar pedal and a collapsing amp. Now trapped in a bizarre, influencer-dominated world, you and Raze must work together to escape four surreal, influencer-run environments built to manipulate and control everyone's thoughts, tastes, and ultimately, spending habits.

Armed with a glitching cybernetic arm that adapts to each world—flame, freeze, electricity, tractor beam—you’ll solve escape-room puzzles, platform through chaotic landscapes, and crush enemies. Dive directly into Raze’s mind, shifting into first-person to unlock her perspective, or use her damaged eye to reveal hidden clues and subvert traps set by MgaFusion’s corporate influencer overlords.

Raze is voiced by Lzzy Hale of Halestorm, who brings her to life with raw, rebellious energy. The soundtrack features tracks from active punk and alt bands, fueling the action with real noise from the underground.

With a narrative full of satirical bite, genre-blending gameplay, and a heroine who embodies DIY ethos, anti-establishment rage, and pitch-black humor—Raze Vol. 1 is more than a VR game. It’s a playable riot against toxic media, fake personas, and the commodification of rebellion.

Story & Arcade Gameplay!

data.short_description: Raze Vol. 1 is a satirical punk rock VR puzzle-platformer. Team up with Raze, a punk guitarist zapped into an influencer-run nightmare. Use her power arm, dive into her mind, and spot hidden clues with her damaged eye. Voiced by Lzzy Hale. Story + Arcade modes. Raze is gonna blaze!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3 / 3s (via Link, Air Link, or Virtual Desktop). Requires Oculus/Meta runtime set as default OpenXR.
  • Additional Notes: This game currently requires the Oculus/Meta runtime set as your default OpenXR in order to run on Quest headsets via Link or Air Link. If SteamVR is set as your default OpenXR runtime, the game will not display in your headset until switched. Tracked Controller Support.
